caption: The drawing features a single rectangular framed portrait set against a plain beige or off-white background. The frame is decorated with a repeating pattern of interlocked “V” shapes and appears to be made of wood with a brown hue. Inside the frame, the image depicts a standing figure of a person with light brown hair wearing a dark, possibly black, coat and trousers, with a tan or light brown scarf or cravat around the neck. The background within the frame is a dark green. The person is seen holding an object, potentially a cane or sword, in one hand while the other hand is placed at the hip. The artist's name, "ELMER WEISE," is printed in uppercase letters on the wall beneath the bottom right corner of the frame.
title: Painted Glass
